previewDeathNotice.description:
John Joe died, unexpectedly, at his home. Sadly missed by his loving sister Patsy, brothers Michael and Kevin, sisters-in-law Mary and Eileen, nieces, nephews, grandnieces, grandnephews, relatives, neighbours and many friends. Predeceased by his parents Michael and Abbie and sister Maureen.

May He Rest In Peace

In keeping with HSE guidelines and in the interest of public health, a private family funeral Mass will take place on Monday, August 31st, at 11am in St Crohan's Church, Caherdaniel. Burial afterwards in Derrynane Abbey. A live stream of John Joe's funeral Mass can be viewed on: www.churchservices.tv/caherdaniel

 



Those who would have liked to attend the funeral but are unable to do so due to the current restrictions, please leave a message in the condolence section below.
